### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

- `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx`  _(via currentRecord (literal, a string literal in declaredArmContext))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via currentRecord (literal, a string literal in declaredArmContext))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **9** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ced0f82bd93260b660e6f448c7dc5952bc82371` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `42c6507374ae802063d32b5d0de6e36d9736e049` — the merge of head `4bc9b0c08be1b3398bd5b3d73136b17f5e8b5a49` into base `1ced0f82bd93260b660e6f448c7dc5952bc82371`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 42c6507374ae802063d32b5d0de6e36d9736e049 && git checkout 42c6507374ae802063d32b5d0de6e36d9736e049
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1ced0f82bd93260b660e6f448c7dc5952bc82371 4bc9b0c08be1b3398bd5b3d73136b17f5e8b5a49 && git checkout -B drift-repro 1ced0f82bd93260b660e6f448c7dc5952bc82371 && git merge --no-ff 4bc9b0c08be1b3398bd5b3d73136b17f5e8b5a49

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ced0f82bd93260b660e6f448c7dc5952bc82371
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1ced0f82bd93260b660e6f448c7dc5952bc82371` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

✅ ACCEPT: PR #23667 at `4bc9b0c08b` (#23531's remainder), round 0. Every check on this head is green or a roster skip; no contract review is owed · 2026-10-15T11:52Z

`domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU` · holder of claim `6189624811`. Report: the `os-dev-report` `6191045281` on #23531.

**Checklist, read against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report:**
- **PR shape:** draft, base `main`, title `fix(plugin-hono-server):`, assignee `sunhaolin`. Line 1 is `Fixes #23531`, the body's only closing keyword; the card closes with this PR. Line 2 is `Clause-②: no`.
- **Scope:** 7 files, +178 / −67.
  - Inside the claim's surface:
    - `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`: `declaredArmContext`'s filter and the three docblock passages that said the field is held;
    - the unit and conformance pin files;
    - one new changeset.
  - Outside it: three docs pages (accepted below).
  - `check-governed-merges --pr 23667`: NOT governed. Merge-tree is clean against `origin/main` `1ced0f82bd`.
- **The fix, read in the diff:**
  - `declaredArmContext` now drops only the arm's own `error` and `code`, so `CONCURRENT_UPDATE`'s `currentRecord` rides `error.details` beside `currentVersion` on both Hono doors.
  - The premise holds on `main`: PR #23628 (`7dc7d2213`) re-reads the row under the caller's context on a version mismatch. A hidden row answers `404` with neither field, and a readable row's record is the caller's masked read.
  - The docblock keeps the rule that matters: an arm that grows a field read with a system context is held by name until its producer reads it as the caller.
  - `metadata-protocol`, `packages/types` and `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` are untouched.
- **Pins and reverse verification:**
  - **Unit pins:** both rows assert `error.details` equal to `{ currentVersion, currentRecord }` exactly.
  - **Conformance pins:** a real `createHonoApp` over the real protocol. They compare the door's details with what the protocol threw (spied). New `PATCH` / `DELETE` rows show a masked field absent from `currentRecord`, which equals the caller's own read, while the store still holds the field.
  - **Ablation:** putting the exclusion back turns 2 unit and 4 conformance rows red. The restore is proven against HEAD, with the dist preflight marker gone.
  - **Parity:** a scratch test on PR #23628's runtime rig (real `SecurityPlugin`, real `RestServer`) found the Hono door's details equal to `RestServer`'s, 4/4. It was never committed.
- **Changeset prose, sentence by sentence:**
  - `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` and `@objectstack/hono` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, as PR #23582 did.
  - The FROM and TO lines match the pinned bodies.
  - "`structuredCodeAnswer` in `@objectstack/types`": true (`data-error-classification.ts:1011`).
  - "`@objectstack/client` reads it as `err.details.currentRecord` on these hosts": true. `client/src/index.ts:7514` falls back to `errorBody.error.details` on the wrapped envelope.
  - The `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` sentence is PR #23628's producer behaviour, quoted, not changed here.
- **Gates:**
  - **Local, at `4bc9b0c08b`:** 95 derived, 95 run, 0 unmeasured, all exit 0. Pass 1 caught `check:query-options-erasure` (two `as any`, 236 → 238), and it was fixed in `bc83077a4f`.
  - **Lint:** narrowed with its three pieces of evidence. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's `Lint · ESLint`.
  - **Gate evidence: the check-runs pinned to `4bc9b0c08b`, read at this stamp.** 41 distinct checks: 36 `success`, including Lint · ESLint, the Type Check family, the Test Core shards, Build Core and Check Changeset, and 5 skipped. All 5 skips are roster names: Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance. Nothing is running and nothing failed.
- **Contract review:** none owed. The change is the Hono doors' forwarding of a field the REST door already sends: `Clause-②: no`, with no schema face and no governed path.

**Accepted deviations:**
- **Three docs pages edited outside the claim's listed surface:** `content/docs/api/index.mdx`, `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`.
  - PR #23616 wrote "a Hono door never sends `currentRecord`" into them, and this change makes that false.
  - The role file has a shipped surface that the round makes false fixed in the round, and it wins over the dispatch's stop-on-breach. The dev named the breach rather than resolving it silently.
  - Each hunk only removes the hold claim and adds the caller's-read sentence. None of them is release text.
- **The two earlier unreleased changesets stay byte for byte** (`.changeset/23531-hono-conflict-body.md:15` and `.changeset/23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md:14`, which say `currentRecord` stays held).
  - This follows #15953 ruling B: an earlier slice's unreleased changeset is not rewritten.
  - The new changeset states that it supersedes the note. This seat carries the "one CHANGELOG story" question to release-text review, and does not edit those files in a code PR.
- **The FLS on the conformance rig is an engine-middleware stand-in.** `http-conformance` does not depend on `plugin-security`, and adding that dependency would mean a lockfile edit outside the claim. The real field- and row-level rules are pinned at the producer (`data-conflict-caller-visibility.test.ts`, 16/16), and the parity measurement covers the door.
- `origin/main` `286eb9ef3` was merged once before the PR opened, by a merge commit. None of its commits touches these files.

**Out-of-scope, Acceptance notes, 「承接者:无」:**
- `data-conflict-caller-visibility.test.ts`'s dispatcher-door rows read `currentRecord` off the thrown error, not the wire. They could now assert the wire.
- `wire-format.mdx`'s flat `Concurrent Update — 409 Conflict` example omits `currentRecord`, which the flat door sends and whose Fields list names it. This is example drift, untouched by this diff.

**Landing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay, in this act.
